notes:
- **Google has verified Archie**, so connecting Gmail or Google Calendar goes straight to Google's
  permission page, with no warning page before it.
- **On Archie for Teams, people have roles.** Make a teammate an admin, who can change the agent and
  who is on it, set what each teammate can do, or hand the agent over to a new owner, with both of
  you told. Archie knows who is at this computer and speaks as them, and an admin can manage the
  people from their phone.
- **Your agent changes the spreadsheets, Word files, decks and text files you give it in their own
  style**, and reads a spreadsheet's row numbers, column letters and formulas, so a change lands in
  the right cell. A file it cannot open gets a note saying how to export one it can.
- **Job Hunt can start from the people you know.** Bring in your LinkedIn connections file and it
  shows where they work and names one person a week to write to.
- **A reply shows the message it answers** at the top of its bubble.
- **The chat moves more smoothly.** A reply types itself out in its own bubble, and the chat glides
  to the newest message and stops following only when you scroll away.
- **The back arrow sits beside each page's title.**
- **Your agent's browser works with a bank's dropdown menus**, finds a file it just downloaded by
  its name, and leaves no blank tabs behind.
- **A skill's checklist stops looking unfinished** once every step is done.
- **On the Account page, Archie asks how you heard about it.** Answering is optional, and nothing is
  sent unless you press an answer.
- **Fixed: a Google refusal said Google might be stopping Archie.** It is just a refusal now.
